title: Validator vote to delist OM
content: {"blocks":[{"key":"d50r4","text":"Validators will vote on whether to delist OM around 8:00 UTC on 23 February. OM is being rebranded to MANTRA. This permissionless stake-based vote weighting primitive is built natively into HyperCore and technically requires no offchain coordination. If validators vote to delist an asset, the perps will settle to the 1 hour time weighted spot oracle price before delisting, and open orders will be canceled. Close any positions beforehand to avoid automatic settlement. After settlement, no new orders will be accepted.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"offset":0,"length":521,"style":"color-rgb(255,255,255)"},{"offset":0,"length":521,"style":"bgcolor-rgb(15,26,31)"},{"offset":0,"length":521,"style":"fontsize-14"},{"offset":0,"length":521,"style":"fontfamily-OurFont, system-ui, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Ubuntu, \"Helvetica Neue\", sans-serif"}],"entityRanges":[],"data":{}}],"entityMap":{}}
